name: Les Histoires Horreurs Interactives
source:
Feelings of torment, heartbreak, screams, anguish, panic, fear await you. 

Will you face your deepest fears in the hope of regaining the precious commodity of freedom? 

Will the choices you make allow you to understand the secrets lurking in the gloomy mansion and its dark mysteries? 

Will you be able to meet the innocent prisoner hiding in the rugged mountains? 

Will you be able to survive through the prison?

[Edited from [url=https://lessdessdouxstudio.itch.io/interactive-horror-stories]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
折磨、心碎、尖叫、煎熬、惊慌与恐惧，都在等待着你。

为了重新获得宝贵的自由，你是否愿意直面内心最深处的恐惧？

你做出的选择，能否让你看清那座阴森宅邸中隐藏的秘密与黑暗谜团？

你能否遇见藏身于崎岖群山中的无辜囚徒？

你能否活着走出那座监狱？

[编译自[url=https://lessdessdouxstudio.itch.io/interactive-horror-stories]itch.io[/url]]
